summary: A multi-seller marketplace where buyers search listings from many independent sellers and choose by seller reputation: search-first home, results with filters (seller rating, category, price, dispatch time), seller pages with ratings and reviews, and a call for new sellers.

pages.purpose: Get buyers searching at once, show the categories and the best-rated sellers, explain how buying from independent sellers works, and recruit sellers.

sections.purpose: Search-first hero: headline, a search field with popular terms, and a collage of listings each with its seller's rating chip.
fields: Featured listings with seller and rating
sections.notes: Submitting the search (or a popular term) opens the results page with the query set.

sections.purpose: A row of categories that open results with the category preset.
fields: Categories with icon or photo and listing count

sections.purpose: Top-rated sellers: rating first, then the evidence (reviews, on-time dispatch, reply time), then a few of their listings.
fields: Sellers: shop name, avatar, rating, review count, on-time share, reply time, three listings
Newest listings: photo, title, price, dispatch time, seller with rating
sections.notes: Every listing card carries the seller chip with rating; the rating button opens a popover with the breakdown (distribution, on-time share, reply time, badge rule) and a link to the shop. Saving a listing is an icon button with an accessible name.

sections.purpose: How buying from many sellers works: one checkout, who ships, buyer protection, disputes.
Scale and trust in numbers: sellers, listings, orders, average rating.
fields: Real figures with the date they were measured

sections.purpose: Invite sellers: fees, payout timing, how to apply.
Buyer and seller questions: returns across sellers, shipping from several sellers, fees.
fields: Questions and answers for buyers and sellers

pages.purpose: Search and narrow listings by seller rating, top-seller badge, category, price range and dispatch time; sort.

sections.purpose: Query, sort, removable active-filter chips, a filter panel (sidebar on wide screens, sheet on phones) and the results grid.
alternatives: sheet: the filter panel on phones
empty-state: no results, with a suggestion to clear filters
fields: Listings with category, price, dispatch time, seller and rating
sections.notes: Each seller-rating filter option shows the live count of results it would give (count with every other filter applied). Announce the result count via aria-live; toggles expose aria-pressed; the phone sheet returns focus to its trigger.

pages.purpose: One seller's shop: header with rating card, then shop, reviews and about tabs; clicking a rating bar filters the reviews.

sections.purpose: Shop name, avatar, location, member since, top-seller badge and the rating card (5 to 1 star bars, on-time share, reply time).
alternatives: record-detail-layout: a seller page with many facts
fields: Seller name, avatar, location, joining date
Rating distribution, on-time dispatch share, average reply time
sections.notes: Rating bars are buttons that filter the reviews tab; give each a name like '5 stars, 82% of reviews'.

sections.purpose: Shop (the seller's listings), Reviews (filterable) and About (story, policies).
fields: Reviews with rating, date and listing
Seller story, shipping and returns policy

pages.purpose: One listing with the seller's reputation beside the buy button.

sections.purpose: Gallery, options, price, dispatch time, add to cart and the seller chip with rating.
fields: Listing photos, title, description, options, price

sections.purpose: More listings from the same seller.

pages.purpose: Cart grouped by seller, each group with its own shipping.

sections.purpose: Lines grouped by seller with shipping per seller and the total.

pages.purpose: One payment for items from several sellers.

sections.purpose: Contact, address, payment and agreements, with the seller of each line visible.
fields: Marketplace terms and each seller's legal identity

pages.purpose: Confirm the order, with one shipment per seller.

sections.purpose: Order number, per-seller shipments and how to contact each seller.
fields: How buyers contact sellers and open a dispute

content: Categories and the listing data model (title, photos, price, options, dispatch time)
Seller profiles: name, avatar, location, story, policies
Rating and review system, and the rule for a top-seller badge
Seller metrics: on-time dispatch share, reply time
Commission, fees and payout schedule for sellers
Buyer protection, returns and dispute process across sellers
Marketplace terms, and each seller's legal identity shown to buyers

styles.name: trustworthy marketplace
styles.why: System fonts and a deep blue accent stay neutral so many sellers' photos sit well together and the platform reads as reliable.

styles.name: dense catalogue
styles.why: For large marketplaces where results density and speed matter more than atmosphere.

pitfalls: Buyers cannot see who the actual seller is (name, legal identity, location) before paying — required for consumer protection and trust.
Ratings without the evidence behind them (count, recency, on-time share) or badges whose rule is not explained.
Filter counts that do not match the results, or filters lost when the language changes.
Phone filter sheet that does not return focus to its trigger, and toggles without aria-pressed.
Shipping and returns unclear when one order has items from several sellers.
Fake or seeded reviews; only show reviews from completed orders.
Seller onboarding page missing fees and payout timing.
